basic_details.job_title: NIT Agartala Library Professional Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Candidates with a First Class (60%) Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS) completed in 2025 or 2026, and below 27 years of age as on 16 October 2026, can appear for the written test/interview for Library Professional Trainee (Fixed Term Internship) at the National Institute of Technology Agartala on 17 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM at the Central Library. Participation must be confirmed by replying to email [email protected] on or before 12 November 2026.

qualification.details: First Class (60%) in Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS). The MLIS must have been completed in 2025 or 2026 only .

salary_details.details: The engagement is a Fixed Term Internship (the application format calls it a "Fixed Period Internship"). The duration of the internship and the stipend are not specified in the notice.

selection_process: Selection for the Library Professional Trainee (Fixed Term Internship) is through a written test/interview held on 17 November 2026 at the Central Library
National Institute of Technology Agartala. The notice does not give the pattern
marks or syllabus of the written test. Candidates must be prepared to stay for one additional day after the scheduled date
how_to_apply: Confirm your participation by replying to the email [email protected] on or before 12 November 2026.
Fill in the Application Format for Library Professional Trainee (Fixed Period Internship) attached to the notice, and paste a passport size photograph in the box provided.
In the form, give your name (in block letters), father's/guardian's name, gender, permanent and correspondence addresses, contact number, email ID, date of birth and age.

List your educational and professional qualifications in chronological order from Secondary (Class X) onwards, with board/university, year of passing, percentage of marks, division/class and subjects.
Give experience details, if any, and the name and address of two references who know your personal and professional qualities, then sign the declaration with date and place.
Prepare three copies of the filled form and report at the Central Library, National Institute of Technology Agartala on 17 November 2026 at 9:00 AM.
All original certificates and mark sheets
Self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates and mark sheets
Self-attested supporting documents for qualifications and experience (as stated in the application format)
Blue/black ballpoint pen for the written test
important_instructions: Visit the institutional website https://www.nita.ac.in regularly for further updates on this recruitment. The declaration in the form states that the candidate is liable for disciplinary action if any detail furnished is found to be untrue.

content_sections.heading: About NIT Agartala
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Technology Agartala (राष्ट्रीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान अगरतला) is a technical institute in Agartala. This notice is signed by the institute's Deputy Librarian, and the written test/interview will be held at the institute's Central Library.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First Class (60%) in Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS). The MLIS must have been completed in 2025 or 2026 only . Candidates must be below 27 years of age as on 16/10/2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates who completed their MLIS before 2025 are not eligible. Only candidates fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria are requested to appear; those who do not meet the eligibility requirements are advised not to report for the test/interview. Candidates should check the full eligibility conditions in the official notification before reporting.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The engagement is a Fixed Term Internship (the application format calls it a "Fixed Period Internship"). The duration of the internship and the stipend are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Confirm your participation by replying to the email [email protected] on or before 12 November 2026. Fill in the Application Format for Library Professional Trainee (Fixed Period Internship) attached to the notice, and paste a passport size photograph in the box provided. In the form, give your name (in block letters), father's/guardian's name, gender, permanent and correspondence addresses, contact number, email ID, date of birth and age. List your educational and professional qualifications in chronological order from Secondary (Class X) onwards, with board/university, year of passing, percentage of marks, division/class and subjects. Give experience details, if any, and the name and address of two references who know your personal and professional qualities, then sign the declaration with date and place. Prepare three copies of the filled form and report at the Central Library, National Institute of Technology Agartala on 17 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. Duly filled Application Form (3 copies) All original certificates and mark sheets Self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates and mark sheets Self-attested supporting documents for qualifications and experience (as stated in the application format) Blue/black ballpoint pen for the written test

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Library Professional Trainee (Fixed Term Internship) is through a written test/interview held on 17 November 2026 at the Central Library, National Institute of Technology Agartala. The notice does not give the pattern, marks or syllabus of the written test. Candidates must be prepared to stay for one additional day after the scheduled date, if required.

faq.question: Q1. When is the NIT Agartala Library Professional Trainee written test/interview?
faq.answer: The written test/interview is on 17 November 2026, with reporting time 9:00 AM, at the Central Library, National Institute of Technology Agartala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to confirm participation?
faq.answer: Candidates must confirm participation by replying to email [email protected] on or before 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Library Professional Trainee post?
faq.answer: A First Class (60%) in Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS), completed in 2025 or 2026 only.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates who completed MLIS in 2024 apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that candidates who completed their MLIS before 2025 are not eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NIT Agartala Library Professional Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 27 years of age as on 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should candidates bring to the test/interview?
faq.answer: The duly filled Application Form (3 copies), all original certificates and mark sheets, self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates and mark sheets, and a blue/black ballpoint pen for the written test.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written test/interview held on 17 November 2026 at the Central Library, National Institute of Technology Agartala.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Library Professional Trainee post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes the post as a Fixed Term Internship.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates need to stay beyond the test date?
faq.answer: Candidates must be prepared to stay for one additional day after the scheduled date, if required.
